fusions.name: Plotted Course
fusions.desc: Casts an arcane bolt at an enemy up to 8 tiles away; it deals 12 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Speaking Trumpet
fusions.desc: Speaks a word of command in a cone 3 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each enemy [Muddled] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Charted Reach
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Logbook Discipline
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
